drawings.description: sous les mots encerclés « Topos non cohérent », un croquis : deux ovales « $Z'$ » et « $Z''$ » qui se recouvrent, la région commune marquée « $I$ » ; au-dessus, entre les deux, « $W$ » ; au-dessous, un trait terminé par une pointe vers le bas.
drawings.kind: two overlapping ovals with a marked intersection, two braces labelled w and v
drawings.notes: Two ovals overlapping: Z' on the left, Z'' on the right (tilted, rising to the right), I in the common region; above them, between the two, W, with a stroke running from it down into the common region. Redrawn 2026-11-13 after the editor's answer (#148: « c'est bien mais les traits à côté de w et v (minuscules) sont des accolades »): the small letter above W at the left is a lowercase w, and the wavy stroke beside it is a brace; the mark under the ovals is a lowercase v (not an arrow head), and the short curved stroke above it, leaving the common region, is a brace. Both braces are drawn as plain brace curves, their tips towards the letters' side as far as the page shows; their exact extent is a reading. Partial: the wavy scribbles inside Z' (left of I) and inside Z'' (right of I) are still not drawn (they may be further braces or small illegible labels); the stroke from W is drawn as one curve where the page has two passes. The ringed words above (Topos non cohérent) are not drawn. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour crop. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription reads « au-dessous, un trait terminé par une pointe vers le bas »: by the editor (#148) the stroke is a brace and the mark under it the letter v; the lowercase w above W and its brace are not in the transcription.
